-- MCP C02 read-only preflight for one existing QA client/account only.
select clock_timestamp() as observed_at,
 (select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'client_type',client_type,'registration_type',registration_type,'token_endpoint_auth_method',token_endpoint_auth_method,'redirect_uris',redirect_uris,'client_name',client_name,'deleted_at',deleted_at,'has_secret_hash',client_secret_hash is not null) from auth.oauth_clients where id='83504d3f-59d4-43fd-99b1-bebc54c40f7d'::uuid) as client835,
 (select count(*) from auth.oauth_consents where client_id='83504d3f-59d4-43fd-99b1-bebc54c40f7d'::uuid and user_id='1f3d7935-1bdc-4952-8d7f-0f72077368c1'::uuid and revoked_at is null) as active_selected_consents,
 (select count(*) from auth.oauth_authorizations where client_id='83504d3f-59d4-43fd-99b1-bebc54c40f7d'::uuid and user_id='1f3d7935-1bdc-4952-8d7f-0f72077368c1'::uuid and expires_at>clock_timestamp()) as unexpired_selected_authorizations;
